text:
maria: Quick heads-up — Acme pilot asked for private deploy with customer-managed keys + HSM, target pilot launch in ~3w. They want 99th p token latency <= 200ms and a dedicated GPU pool. Need to align product/eng/runtime/infra/security sequencing and decide MVP tradeoffs. Who can confirm constraints?
tom: Clarifying Q — is the MVP just text gen (sync) or do they need streaming/function-calls/embeddings in pilot?
maria: MVP = text gen only, single-turn, no tools or function-calls. Embeddings and reranking later. HSM is for customer key custody requirement.
sanjay: From runtime side — single-turn helps. For 200ms p99 we need prewarmed KV cache + quantized model build. If we use q4_0 / kernel v1.2 we can hit it on 4 x A100-80GB or 6 x A40s depending on seq lengths. Need traffic profile (rps, typical seq len).
elaine: Infra note — ordering/provisioning for dedicated pools + HSM appliance takes time. HSM add-on (on-prem or cloud HSM) is ~10 business days for procurement + certs. We can do a KMS-based setup faster (~2 days) with customer-managed keys in their cloud account.
kevin: Security: HSM gives better key isolation but has ops + attestation. Product Ops — can we accept KMS for pilot? We'll need an SSP checklist, egress rules locked down, and audit logging enabled. If pilot is revenue-sensitive, HSM should be roadmap-tied but not mandatory day-1.
jess: Proposed rollout: internal canary (team+SRE), partner pilot with Acme (limited feature set), then widen. Canary config: 0.5% -> 5% -> PD. Fallback policy to hosted Redwood API if dedicated pool degrades.
tom: Engineering compromise — we can decouple HSM from runtime by isolating key ops in a proxy service. That lets runtime use cached tokens and avoids HSM latency in hot path. Short-term: KMS + proxy. Long-term: swap proxy to HSM-backed service.
maria: Sounds reasonable. Product suggests pilot uses customer-managed KMS (in-customer account) + proxy to satisfy key custody, with HSM planned post-pilot. Can infra/security confirm they can support KMS on this timeline?
elaine: Confirming infra can provision the KMS integration + dedicated GPU pool with prewarm flags in ~48-72 hrs for the KMS path. HSM still 10bd. Need PO and infra ticket to prioritize.
kevin: Security ok with KMS path if: 1) network isolation (VPC peering, no egress to public), 2) audit logs shipped to customer's SIEM, 3) rotation process documented. I'll run through checklist and post approvals.
sanjay: Action items and quick rollout policy snippet below. I'll own model build + perf gates.
```
rollout_policy:
  canary: 0.5%
  ramp: 5% after 24h stable
  fallback: route->hosted if p95_latency > 120ms or error_rate > 1%
perf_gates:
  p99_latency <= 200ms
  model_regression: perplexity delta < 0.5
  smoke_checks: 100 deterministic prompts pass
```
deploy-bot: deployment ticket created: infra-5421 (private-pilot-kms) — https://tracker/redwood/infra-5421
maria: Great progress. Let's sync Wed 10am to lock sequencing and PO ownership. I'll create the calendar + meeting notes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
